name: Diff Viewer
description: Renders unified diffs with ANSI colors and exposes a ShowDiff tool.

tool.name: ShowDiff
tool.description: Render a unified diff with ANSI colors and return the rendered output. Use this when you want to display a concrete diff inline in the conversation (instead of pasting raw patch text). The `patch` argument must be a unified diff string (the output of `git diff`, `diff -u`, etc.).

patch.description: The unified diff text to render.

title.description: Optional heading shown above the diff.
